page.text:
Multiplication $\cdot : \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ is
defined by primitive recursion as repeated addition:
$$\begin{aligned}
0 \cdot m &:= 0 \\
S(k) \cdot m &:= (k \cdot m) + m
\end{aligned}$$
Multiplying $n$ by $m$ computes the sum of $n$ copies of $m$, with $0$
acting as the annihilating zero element.
